questions.question: Team ES2013 weighed several energy sources for their remote. Which options were discussed, which one did they settle on in their third meeting, and was it still the choice in the final costing?
questions.gold_answer: Batteries (including the idea of a rechargeable internal battery), solar power and kinetic energy were discussed. In meeting c the consensus was kinetic energy, if at all possible, and in meeting d the final costing still used a single kinetic energy source.

gold_citations.quote: So the consensus seems to be use the kinetic if it's at all possible.
we would use plastic with a rubber casing, I think was the consensus, powered by kinetic energy

questions.question: In Team IS1006, who first proposed making the remote out of titanium and why, what was said about rubber as an alternative, and which material did the final design keep?
